other_specific_findings: Admetos: gründliche Kultur-Erneuerung means thorough cultural renewal, not grim cultural reflection; unterdrückte Wahrheit is suppressed truth.
Apollon: Erneuerung means renewal; vernünftige Impulse der Freiheit is rational impulses of freedom.
Asc: aufregende is exciting, not enormous; vernünftige Technik is rational technology, not future technology.
Hades: mangelhaftes Kultur-Ereignis is a deficient cultural event; verborgene kulturelle Erneuerung is hidden cultural renewal.
Jupiter: vernünftiges Rechts-Ereignis is a rational legal event, not powerful; Erneuerung is renewal.
Kronos: erneuerte/neue geistige Autorität is renewed/new intellectual authority, not authoritarianism; staatliche Reform-Ideen is state reform ideas.
MC: Erregte Geist-Seele and seelische Erregung durch Wahrheit restore the damaged opening and close.
Mercury: Gespräche über geistige Erneuerung is conversations about intellectual renewal; Verkehrs-Technik is transport technology.
Moon: überraschende Gefühls-Klarheit is surprising clarity of feeling; gendered wording preserved.
Saturn: ernstes Kultur-Ereignis is a serious cultural event; gestörte geistige Konzentration is disturbed mental concentration.
Sun: restored eighth clause überraschende Klarheit für eine Person; gendered wording preserved.
Venus: Erneuerung is renewal, not emergence.
Vulcanus: mächtige Erneuerung der Kultur is powerful cultural renewal.
Zeus: Erneuerung der geistigen Führung is renewal of spiritual leadership, not filthyness; geistige Reformen beginnen is beginning spiritual reforms.
Mars, Node and Vernal Point: every clause matches its own scan row; English grammar regularized without new doctrine.
